audit.summary: The 320×480 ad creative has several critical and minor issues: (1) Pagination dots are visible (6 dots) with only 1 working carousel slide, violating the carousel blocker rule; (2) Primary CTA button lacks required bottom padding/safe margin and sits too close to the bottom frame edge; (3) Product headline text is too faint/low-contrast in initial state (fades in during animation); (4) Typography hierarchy needs reinforcement — subheading 'COLLECTION OFFICIELLE' is undersized and low-contrast.

findings.issue: Carousel pagination dots (6 dots visible) present with only 1 functional slide. Orphan/orphaned dots must be hidden when carousel has ≤1 working slide.
findings.fix_hint: Hide pagination dots via CSS: `.carousel-dots { display: none; }` or conditionally render only if slide count > 1. Verify carousel backend tracks slide count before rendering dots.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button 'DÉCOUVRIR LA COLLECTION' sits too close to the bottom edge of #ad-320x480 with insufficient safe margin. Text and button frame lack the recommended 20px padding buffer from the bottom ad boundary.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom to #ad-320x480 or margin-bottom to the CTA container: `.cta-button { margin-bottom: 20px; }` or wrap CTA in a container with `padding-bottom: 20px;`.

findings.issue: Product headline text 'Construis ton aventure Pokémon' and subheading 'COLLECTION OFFICIELLE' are nearly invisible in initial state (very faint/low opacity) and only become readable during animation. Initial state should have legible text from load.
findings.fix_hint: In initial state, set headline opacity to 1 (or remove opacity animation start): `.headline { opacity: 1; }` in base styles. Keep animation triggered only on subsequent events, not on page load default.

findings.issue: Subheading 'COLLECTION OFFICIELLE' is too small and low-contrast (light gray on white background). Hierarchy is unclear — the tagline should be visually distinct from body copy.
findings.fix_hint: Increase font-size of `.subheading { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #000000; }` and ensure it uses bold Cera Pro 700 from the style guide. Consider adding a top border or accent color bar above the headline.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
1. Hide carousel pagination dots: add `display: none;` to `.carousel-dots` or conditionally render only if > 1 slide.
2. Add `margin-bottom: 20px;` to CTA button container for safe bottom margin inside ad frame.
3. Remove opacity fade-in animation from initial state — set headline/subheading to `opacity: 1;` on page load, animate only on user interaction or after a delay.
4. Increase `.subheading` (COLLECTION OFFICIELLE) to `font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #000000;` and apply bold Cera Pro 700.
5. Verify carousel slide count; if only 1 slide exists, do not render dots at all.
